BrochureContent.Content:
Sherry Fitzgerald Paul Reynolds are delighted to present to market this 4 bedroom semi-detached property in the modern development of 'Lios an Chnoic.

This property offers bright, spacious accommodation, finished to a high standard with quality specifications throughout. Built with energy efficiency in mind, it combines modern comfort with sustainable living. An ideal choice for first-time buyers, those looking to downsize, or investors seeking a high-quality home.

The property is located just 2km from Letterkenny town centre offering easy access to all local amenities.

Images shown are for illustrative purposes only; finishes and specifications may vary, but will be of a similar standard and style.
